commits.message: CollageMaker: add focus trap to mobile bottom sheet (aria-modal) — 14 unit tests, 7 e2e tests, skill docs

notes: Committed pre-staged changes for the bottom sheet focus trap feature. The staged changes included: (1) focus trap implementation in createCollageMethods.js using factory-scoped closures to avoid `this` binding issues, (2) lifecycle cleanup hook in createCollageLifecycle.js, (3) 14 unit tests in BottomSheetTest.html covering Tab/Shift+Tab wrapping, hidden panel exclusion, empty list handling, and integration with toggleBottomSheet/closeSidebars/bsTouchEnd, (4) 7 E2E tests in test/e2e/bottom-sheet.spec.js using Playwright at 375x667 mobile viewport, (5) skill documentation updates across 6 files. All changes were already staged before this session.
